answer: Operator-Liability Quota Escrow. Each operator must lock a per-identity escrow, encrypted under their own cipher, before any wallet can transact. When a cluster exceeds a fraud threshold, a deterministic quill audit signs off and the escrow slashes across all that operator's identities, not just the offending wallet. Attackers must front the full escrow on every sybil and lose the canyon of collateral the moment detection lands.
